payload.title: Define counting semantics and golden counting tests
payload.description:
Define and implement the counting semantics: each match occurrence increments its family token count; a message contributes at most once per family to the message-level count; the meter gauge uses token counts. Pin golden expected counts for the fixture corpus.

Done when: occurrence and message-level counts are both produced; golden counting tests over the fixture skeleton pass deterministically; the same input always yields the same counts.
